metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for personal workflows.

plugins.name: kivi-sdlc
plugins.description: Personal SDLC workflow for Claude Code. /recon frames a task and gauges whether it's ready to plan, /plan makes the design decisions, /work implements and commits, /respond handles PR review. Each run through the pipeline is recorded as a campaign beside the ticket or spec file (a tracker comment or a markdown file), so every skill picks up where the last one left off without touching your prose. /carve splits an epic into pipeline-ready pieces, /warroom drives 2-3 tickets to open PRs at once, and /uav digs through git and ticket history when a question needs it.
